verdict.rationale: Solid's docs describe a predictable reactive model: only code that depends on changed state reruns, accessing state subscribes to it automatically, and components run once. A long-term user reports that immediate reactivity keeps state changes intuitive and easy to debug. However, the evidence never mentions explicit unidirectional data flow or the absence of two-way bindings, dependency tracking is described as automatic rather than explicit, and one hands-on critique calls the dev tools alpha/unusable, which limits tracing tooling. Missing for 10: documentation of one-way data flow or read/write separation versus two-way binding, mature state-tracing/devtools support, independent corroboration of explicit traceability.
